entities.summary: Cherniaev, a notable figure in the history of Uzbekistan, associated with Russian Conquest of Central Asia (1839–1876). Their legacy influenced General Cherniaev captures Tashkent in an unauthorized assault and Russia defeats the Emirate of Bukhara and establishes a protectorate.
